intent: The authenticated pre-editor file surface: a two-pane shell whose collection shows at most five cards per row.
guidance: A two-pane shell — a 241px sidebar and a scrolling content pane — that owns the canonical grid. The track rule caps the collection at five cards per row and falls back to an honest 4 / 3 / 2 / 1 below ~1088px, so the collection, folder, trash, and skeleton grids stay in lockstep from one definition. It holds no repository, auth, or routing state: pass `stateKind` plus the collection items and wire the callbacks. Carry loading with the skeleton grid alone (no separate spinner), and render a state panel for empty, search-empty, and load-failure. Visual direction for the cards follows the Editor Study reference.
use_when: The signed-in projects / home file browser — create, find, open, and manage projects.
An inventory surface that needs the capped card grid, a list toggle, and empty / loading / error states.
dont_use_when: The public entry surface — use LandingTemplate.
A single dialog or panel — this owns the whole screen.

anatomy.description: 241px column: account chip, workspace switcher, search, nav (Recents / Drafts / All projects / Trash), Starred, brand.
Page title + the primary actions (New project / Share).
Sort control + the grid / list view toggle.
The card grid — at most five per row, fewer only when the width can't honestly carry five — or the list of rows; the host renders the items.
Shown in place of the collection for loading (skeleton), empty, search-empty, or load-failure.

states: empty (explains no projects, offers New project)
search-empty (keeps the query, offers a reset)

slots.title: Page title in the top bar.

tokens.note: Token-bound (c-* tokens). The grid track sizes — 240px floor, 32px gap, five-column cap — are layout constants from the spec, not colors.

a11y.keyboard: focus follows document order; nav items expose their selected state
a11y.note: The host supplies accessible names for cards, menus, and the sidebar controls.
